cases.query: We're redesigning the dashboard while another dev ships features — how should we branch and slice reviewable PRs?

This redesign mixes token, component, and data changes — slice it into reviewable changes around user outcomes.
We authorized a framework upgrade and another contributor has unrelated edits — who owns the manifest and lockfile update?
Write an AGENTS.md capturing our commands, paths, and review expectations for future agents.
Plan the repo folders, env setup, and first slice for our new project.
Implement the checkout flow end-to-end with auth, recovery, and persistence in our existing codebase.
Define semantic color tokens with light and dark pairs for our dashboard.
Plan the dashboard shell with sidebar, header, and responsive collapse for tables.
